properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Genuine AES-128 use: "cipher":"aes-128-ctr" in the V3 keystore fixture, the production wallet's legacy key-at-rest format (decrypted via the TrustKeystore pod from LegacyFileBasedKeystore). AES-128 retains a 64-bit quantum margin under Grover — not urgent, but below CNSA 2.0's AES-256 requirement. The cipher is pinned by the Web3 Secret Storage spec, so it is changeable only by migrating the at-rest format, not by a config flag.
